Lemma
[Smoothness of the Pairing of Smooth Sections]

↗ def:smooth-field-scalar-products

Let $g$ be a smooth field of scalar products on $V\to B$, let $f\colon N\to B$ be smooth on $s\subseteq N$, and let $v,w$ be sections along $f$ that are smooth on $s$. Then \[ x\longmapsto g_{f(x)}(v_x,w_x) \] is smooth on $s$. In particular, this holds for globally smooth sections along a smooth map.

Proof

↗ def:smooth-field-scalar-products \sketch In a local trivialization over $f(x_0)$, the field $g$ becomes a smooth map to the fixed space of bilinear forms on the model fibre, and $v,w$ become smooth model-fibre-valued maps. Compose these maps with the smooth evaluation $(\beta ,y,z)\mapsto \beta (y,z)$.

□
